rows.source: Bonjour Yes yes
rows.translation: 你好啊，是的

rows.source: You are for the tour Très bien
rows.translation: 欢迎参加这次旅游！

rows.source: Welcome mes amis Welcome to Paris City Tours
rows.translation: 欢迎各位朋友，欢迎来到巴黎城市游

rows.source: Today I show you the real Paris
rows.translation: 今天我带你们看看真正的巴黎

rows.source: Follow me Allé allé this way mes amis
rows.translation: 走吧，朋友们，跟我来

rows.source: Here Place de la Bastille Very important for us in France
rows.translation: 这里就是巴士底广场，对我们法国来说很重要

rows.source: And this column commemorates the Revolution of 1813 Very important yes
rows.translation: 还有这根柱子纪念1813年的革命，非常重要

rows.source: Oh little bit to the left This way Very good
rows.translation: 哦，稍微往左一点，这边来，很好

rows.source: Stay close Bon bon we continue
rows.translation: 跟紧点，好好的，我们继续走

rows.source: Vite vite Ah very good Keep moving mes amis
rows.translation: 快点快点，很好，朋友们，继续前进

rows.source: Perfect Oh small detour Much better this side
rows.translation: 完美哦，小绕道更好了

rows.source: The fresh air Voilà
rows.translation: 新鲜空气来了，真棒

rows.source: The famous Moulin Rouge and of course the Eiffel Tower
rows.translation: 著名的红磨坊，当然还有埃菲尔铁塔

rows.source: And here voilà hung the Mona Lisa
rows.translation: 这里就是蒙娜丽莎的画像

rows.source: Ah a little shower Très refreshing no
rows.translation: 啊，来个淋浴，真清爽

rows.source: This neighborhood is famous
rows.translation: 这个街区很有名

rows.source: for its intellectual conversations
rows.translation: 以思想交流著称

rows.source: Very passionate people the French Ah the croissant Très French
rows.translation: 很有激情的法国人，啊，还有羊角面包，真法式

rows.source: Our newest recipe mes amis
rows.translation: 这是我们最新的食谱，朋友们

rows.source: Here very good for shopping Très chic
rows.translation: 这里购物很赞，超有范

rows.source: Everybody duck Vite vite Très bien
rows.translation: 大家快蹲下 快点 快点 很好

rows.source: Everybody look happy
rows.translation: 大家都露出开心的表情

rows.source: And from here you have the most beautiful view of Paris
rows.translation: 从这里可以看到巴黎最美的景色

rows.source: Well here we are Your hotel Au revoir Au revoir Merci Bouboo
rows.translation: 好了，到了你的酒店 再见 再见 谢谢 拜拜

rows.source: Enjoy the rest of your stay in Paris
rows.translation: 祝你在巴黎的其余时间玩得开心
